ゾリャー校区の街中を歩いていると――: While walking through the streets of the Zorya school district...
ああ、オルガとナージャか。\nふたりとも確かに奇遇――って、え？:
Oh, Olga and Nadja.
Yeah, fancy meeting you both... Wait, huh?
そこで出会ったオルガたちは、なぜかパイロットスーツ姿だった。: For some reason, the two of them were wearing their pilot suits.
えっと、さっきまで市街地での特別訓練を行っていたんです。\n実験機での訓練だった:
Um, we were doing special training in town until just now.
We had to wear pilot suits because we were using experimental machines...
そういうことです。しかし訓練の機密性の都合から、\nこの辺りの立ち入りは制限され:
Correct. But access to this area should be restricted
because the training is classified... Why are you here?
本当だ、立ち入り禁止の連絡が来てるな……: You're right. There's a notice saying the area is off-limits...
端末を確認すると、確かに立ち入り禁止の通達が届いていた。: I checked my terminal. Sure enough, an access restriction notice had arrived.
全く……連絡の確認を怠るとは、会長の苦労が偲ばれますね。: Really... Failing to check your messages. I can see why the president has so much trouble.
……昔のレドフカなら、問答無用で拘束されていたかもしれません。\n特に今回は、機:
...In the old Redovka, you might have been detained without question.
Especially with training as highly classified as this...
既に昔とは違いますが……それでもあなたの立場によっては、\n『それなりの対処』が:
Things have changed since then... Even so, depending on your position,
we might have had to take "appropriate measures."
そ、そこまでだったのか……\nちなみに『それなりの対処』って、どんなことをされる:
I-it was that serious...?
What exactly do you mean by "appropriate measures"?
興味本位で聞いてみるが、ナージャは俺から目をそらし、オルガは\nいつもの感情が読:
I asked out of curiosity, but Nadja looked away. Olga
kept her usual unreadable expression. Neither answered.
あー、すまん……端末を部屋に忘れちまったんだ。\nそんな通達があったんだな。:
Ah, sorry... I left my terminal in my room.
I didn't know there had been a notice.
……忘れたという過失はありますが、\n同時に情状酌量の余地もあるようですね。:
...Forgetting it was negligent,
but there do appear to be mitigating circumstances.
……えっと、何がよかったんだ？\nそれに情状酌量の余地って……？:
...Um, what is?
And what do you mean, mitigating circumstances...?
機密性の高い訓練でしたから。あなたがここに現れた理由次第では、\nスパイ行為だと:
The training was highly classified. Depending on why you came here,
you could have been suspected of espionage.
はい、スパイさんだと思われたら――: Yes. If they thought you were a spy...
……思われたら？: ...If they thought I was a spy?
……えっと、その、いろいろと大変なことになっていたかもしれません。: ...Um, well... Things might have become rather complicated.
曖昧に言葉を濁しつつ、困り顔を浮かべるナージャを見ながら、\n俺はきちんと端末を:
Watching Nadja awkwardly evade the question,
I vowed to make sure I always carried my terminal.
